_comment_azuread: The CHO API app registration. The portal requests api://<ClientId>/Cho.Token for the signed-in user and forwards that token here.

TokenService._comment_platform: CHO's own Entra directory id. Override: TokenService__PlatformTenantId. Empty disables platform administration.

_comment_signing: Production signs inside Key Vault: TokenSigning__KeyVaultKeyId=https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/keys/cho-token-signing. See docs/security/portal-token-service.md.
_comment_workload: Argo workflows: POST /v1/token/workload. Off until a cluster issuer and registrations are configured. See docs/security/argo-service-tokens.md.
_comment_service_tokens: CHO services: POST /v1/token/service, by Azure workload identity. Off until a directory, audience and the service registry are configured. token-service also signs its own tenant-service token under this issuer. See docs/security/portal-token-service.md (Service tokens).
_comment_choauth: token-service's own client id for calls to tenant-service. A local signing key here (PrivateKeyPem/SymmetricKey) is accepted only on Development/Testing hosts; deployed, the token is signed under ServiceTokens:Issuer.
